title: Yooka-Laylee’s free upgrade is skipping Xbox
description: Playtronic Games is getting ready to launch Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition as a free update on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC on December 15th. Unfortunately for Xbox owners, the developer says it "can't commit to any additional platforms for the foreseeable future." In a statement posted on X, Playtronic said that […]
